digest.component_or_area: Ruff lint configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global Ruff configuration via pyproject.toml after all source and test violations are resolved.

Timestamp validation in validate_checks.py must use explicit UTC timezone semantics: epoch timestamps via datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and persisted timezone-less strings via datetime.datetime.strptime(...).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).
Security-pin cadence decision in security_pin.py must obtain an aware current instant with explicit tz argument, convert to host timezone, extract local date, and pass DTZ005 validation.

Create and own tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert ASYNC and DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, absence of Semgrep config files, and absence of literal datetime.UTC token from src/rebar Python files.

Prove UTC timestamp clustering is timezone-invariant by running validation behavior under at least two distinct TZ values on POSIX/macOS platforms via time.tzset(), with explicit skip on unsupported platforms.
Resolve all current ASYNC and DTZ diagnostics across src/rebar and tests (6 sites: 3 source + 3 test drift) before enabling the ratchet.
